english.title: Use prohibited means to capture / kill protected species causing disappearance or disturbance of animal
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) for the purpose of capturing or killing

(A)_[a wild animal,]_
(B)_[wild animals,]_

of a

(C)_[species listed in Schedule 4 to]_
(D)_[European protected species, where the capturing or killing of such animals was permitted in accordance with]_

the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017, namely **(..SPECIFY ANIMALS..), used a means of capturing or killing which was indiscriminate and capable of causing the local disappearance of, or serious disturbance to, a population of any species of animal listed in Schedule 4 or any European protected species of animal
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 45(2)(c), (4) and (6) of the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: Schedule 4 to the Conservation of Habitats and Species Regulations 2017 lists animals which may not be captured or killed in certain ways.
